text:
A 1-carat natural diamond can cost around $4,000–$6,000, depending on the quality. Even if you get a good resale price, you can still lose a significant amount of what you paid.

A 1-carat lab-grown diamond can cost around $700–$1,200.

So even if you lose most of the value of the lab-grown diamond or simply lose the stone, your financial loss is still much lower than with a natural diamond.

At the end of the day, you are risking much less money with a lab-grown diamond.
